label: end of long original sequence that began with m (esp. input z / <DEL>)
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.003% of steps). Fires almost only in sequences whose first original token is m (88% of mass), at the last one or two original-phase steps or the <DEL> step (t=6-9, never in the copy phase), and mostly when L is 8-9. The input at the firing step is usually z (62% of mass); the strongest activations (up to 4.2) are on z as the last or second-to-last original token, with lower values on <DEL>. Among sequences that start with m, prefixes with v/x/q/p after the m look enriched, but no simple token-set condition separates active from inactive cases. The necessary conditions (starts with m, end of a long original phase) cover about 68% of mass, but precision is under 1%: most such steps stay silent, so the true trigger is a rarer conjunction this predicate does not capture. Does not fire on copy-phase steps, on short sequences (L<=6), or early in the sequence.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=m (+4.22), prev_tok=q (+2.60), orig1=v (+2.39), orig2=x (+2.22), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=z (+2.13), phase=0 & in_tok=z (+2.13). Lower it: phase=2 (-2.44), next_out=- (-2.21), orig8=- (-1.42), orig7=- (-1.27).
